title: Prime Minister pays tribute to Babu Jagjivan Ram on his Birth Anniversary
content:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister pays tribute to Babu Jagjivan Ram on his Birth Anniversary Posted On:
                05 APR 2026 9:05AM by PIB Delhi The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has paid tributes to former Deputy Prime Minister, Babu Jagjivan Ram on his birth anniversary. Shri Modi said that Babu Jagjivan Ram dedicated his life to the ideals of equality and social justice. He added that the nation will always remember his invaluable contribution to the country. The Prime Minister wrote in X; “पूर्व उप प्रधानमंत्री बाबू जगजीवन राम जी को उनकी जयंती पर शत-शत नमन। उन्होंने समानता और सामाजिक न्याय के लिए अपना जीवन समर्पित कर दिया। देश के लिए उनका अमूल्य योगदान सदैव स्मरणीय रहेगा।” पूर्व उप प्रधानमंत्री बाबू जगजीवन राम जी को उनकी जयंती पर शत-शत नमन। उन्होंने समानता और सामाजिक न्याय के लिए अपना जीवन समर्पित कर दिया। देश के लिए उनका अमूल्य योगदान सदैव स्मरणीय रहेगा। — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) April 5, 2026 **** MJPS/ST (Release ID: 2249078) Visitor Counter : 94 Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister pays tribute to Babu Jagjivan Ram on his Birth Anniversary Posted On:

title: Prime Minister extends Easter Greetings
content:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister extends Easter Greetings Posted On:
                05 APR 2026 9:02AM by PIB Delhi The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has extended greetings on the occasion of Easter. The Prime Minister said that this sacred day celebrates hope and renewal. He expressed that Easter may bring peace, joy and brightness to everyone’s lives. Shri Modi further stated that the teachings of Jesus Christ should inspire all to be kind and strengthen the spirit of togetherness in society. The Prime Minister wrote on X; “Greetings on Easter. This sacred day celebrates hope and renewal. May it bring peace, joy and brightness to everyone’s lives. May the teachings of Jesus Christ inspire all to be kind and strengthen the spirit of togetherness in society.” Greetings on Easter. This sacred day celebrates hope and renewal. May it bring peace, joy and brightness to everyone’s lives.
